themes.label: 考试与评分
themes.selection: 选课前核对当期考试权重和题型，评估它与同学期其他课程的考试安排。
themes.study: 尽早确认考试范围与题型，复习时做限时练习，不只背熟已有答案。

themes.label: 作业与项目
themes.selection: 把作业和项目放进整学期时间表，再决定是否与其他任务密集的课程同修。
themes.study: 拿到任务后先拆分里程碑，尽早做出可检查的初稿，预留修改时间。

themes.label: 练习与复习
themes.selection: 如果希望靠持续练习提升表现，可重点比较评价中提到的练习方式和时间投入。
themes.study: 每周整理错题与概念，先独立完成练习，再用不同题型检验理解。

evidence.quote: But you need to do more practice in order to get good grades.

themes.label: 课堂参与
themes.selection: 关注当期课堂参与和考勤说明；往届学生的经历不能直接代替本学期要求。
themes.study: 开课时确认参与分与考勤规则，把课堂活动和提交期限记进日历。

themes.label: 阅读与表达
themes.selection: 如果本学期已有多门阅读或汇报课程，先比较各门课的交付时间再组合。
themes.study: 读材料时记录论点和依据；写作或汇报先列提纲，再检查表达与引用。

sections.content:
Syllabus:
- Integration techniques: integration by parts, trigonometric substitutions and trigonometric integrals, partial fractions.
- Numerical integration.
- Improper integrals.
- Application of integrals: areas, volumes, arc lengths, areas of surfaces of revolution, work, probability distributions

- Limits of infinite sequences.
- Convergence/Divergence of infinite series.
- Power series and Taylor series

- Vector operations
- Dot product and cross product
- Parametric curves and polar coordinates

The syllabus is similar to HKALE Pure Mathematics actually.
sections.teaching: Good teacher, but sometimes may be boring. He also gave us some MATH 1014 exercises to us.
sections.grading:
Quite fair.

There are 4 Assignments, my grades:
1: 98/100
2: 97/100
3. 90/100
4. 80/100

Mid-term Exam: 34/50 (68%)
Final Exam: 81/100 (81%)

Total: 79.15% (B+)
sections.workload: The work load is pretty low actually, maybe because it is for secondary school students.

sections.content:
Part I:
1. Basic Concepts in Calculus
- limit
- continuity
- intermediate value theorem
- extreme value theorem
- derivatives
- mean value theorem
- chain rule/ substitution rule
- fundamental theorem of calculus

2. Integration
- integration techniques: by parts/ trigonometric substitutions/ partial fractions
- application of integrals
- numerical integration
- improper integration

Part II:
3. Infinite Sequence and Series
- limit of infinite series
- convergence/ divergence
- tests: divergent test/ integral test/ comparison test/ limit comparison test/ ratio test/ root test/ alternating series test

4. Power Series
- radius of convergence
- Taylor’s theorem
- Taylor’s Series

5. Parametric Curves
- slope of tangents
- polar coordinates

6. Vectors
- dot/ cross product
- equations of lines snd planes in R3

7. Differential Equations
- 1st order ODE
sections.teaching: Avery is super nice. He was so willing to answer your questions whenever you have any problems. Discussion between students and Avery was fun. He always went into some higher level of maths that encouraged us to explore more.
sections.grading:
Attendance 5%
Assignment 15%
Mid-term exam 30%
Final exam 50%

My result:
Attendance 5/5
Assignment 14.5/15
Mid-term exam 42/50 (I didn’t have time to study)
Final exam 100/100 (The problem on differential equation is quite challenging although he did not have time to go through the lecture notes)
Final grade: A
You need to score super high in order to get an A+
sections.workload: Light Workload with only 6 sets of assignments. But you need to do more practice in order to get good grades. One midterm and one final. Similar as other math courses.

sections.content:
It covers mainly the basics of Analysis of functions. Later on there will also be insights into basic integration up to differentiating functions with a plynom of grade 4 and above.
Students learn about all the main content of Calculus I and II in course. Therefore it is very time intesifying and should be absloved only with prior math knowledge.
sections.teaching: As everything is written on internet presentations, it is not necessary to go to the teaching. I aquired my knowledge mostly online.
sections.grading: The grading is hard, but quite fair, due to the fact that the exam only targets exactly the topics that were targeted by the Presentation.
sections.workload: If youre good in Math it is not a lot of workload. Though, if basic abilities are missing it can get challengeging. You should consider spending at least 10 hours into the course weekly if you want to master it with an A
